rawFindings.title: Incorrect order in trimming prefix matching in router.handle
rawFindings.explanation: The original code checks if (layerPath.length !== 0) before validating the path separator character after the layerPath in the request path. The patch reverses this order, first accessing path[layerPath.length] without ensuring layerPath is non-empty, then conditionally returning next(layerError) if the character is invalid, and only after this performing the length check and trim. Calling path[layerPath.length] when layerPath is empty leads to incorrect behavior or runtime errors. The correct l
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original ordering by first checking if (layerPath.length !== 0) before accessing path[layerPath.length] and validating the character, then trimming the prefix as before.
